caldav_tasks|CREATE TABLE `caldav_tasks` (`cd_id` INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL, `cd_task` INTEGER NOT NULL, `cd_calendar` TEXT, `cd_remote_id` TEXT, `cd_object` TEXT, `cd_etag` TEXT, `cd_last_sync` INTEGER NOT NULL, `cd_deleted` INTEGER NOT NULL, `cd_remote_parent` TEXT, `gt_moved` INTEGER NOT NULL, `gt_remote_order` INTEGER NOT NULL, FOREIGN KEY(`cd_task`) REFERENCES `tasks`(`_id`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE CASCADE )
